study: FSFFL NEXT frozen identity/materialization dependency recovery
authority: research-only recovery; no refit, retraining, reselection, materialization, sentinel parity, or Shapley
decision: The frozen selected-candidate fit and its fitted parameters are recoverable, but the exact current-player-to-historical identity/materialization dependency is not recoverable from the frozen durable evidence. Exact current-player materialization therefore stops at the identity boundary.

frozen_candidate.name: fixed routed Forecast + M1a + two-prior-season consistency
frozen_candidate.scope: positive future-state conditional-production means only; persistence and state probabilities remain frozen

exact_historical_current_fit.training_cutoff_rule: Use only positive source/target transitions with source_season + horizon <= evaluation source cutoff; historical source rows end at 2022. Refit was not performed in this recovery.
exact_historical_current_fit.m1a: BayesianRidge(fit_intercept=False) of target within-state residual z on current within-state residual z; apply predicted residual z through the frozen training-fold state-SD hierarchy; floor adjusted positive-state means at zero.
exact_historical_current_fit.consistency: BayesianRidge(fit_intercept=False) on target residual z minus frozen M1a prediction. Features, in coefficient order: mean_global, gap_global, coverage_global, mean_dev_QB, gap_dev_QB, mean_dev_RB, gap_dev_RB, mean_dev_WR, gap_dev_WR, mean_dev_TE, gap_dev_TE. prior2_mean=mean(z[t-1],z[t-2]); prior2_gap=abs(z[t-1]-z[t-2]); both continuous values are zero and coverage=0 unless both genuine prior seasons exist. Covered values use training-only population moments (ddof=0).

git.result: No final current-player materializer, row-complete identity bridge, or 335-player table with 2024/2023 PIT residual inputs.

durable_repository.result: Recovered the frozen fit metadata and parameters, current I1 facts, Phase 2 panel/age-state rows, and the later 335-player Year-1 universe. No row-level resolved historical key is persisted for the current universe.

github_actions.logs_result: The activation job created /tmp/private_beta_completed_source_points.csv and /tmp/nflreadpy-cache, constructed the stable-ID bridge in memory, and uploaded only artifacts/implementation/private-beta-activation/*. The bridge, source-points CSV, and cache were not uploaded. The workflow used no actions/cache persistence step.
github_actions.cache_endpoint: Not exposed by the connected GitHub interface; workflow definition and logs show no explicit persisted Actions cache for the missing objects.

local_remnants.result: Only the older Phase34 routed sentinel runner/report remnants and the Phase 2 archive were found; neither contains the selected-candidate final identity bridge or row-complete historical inputs.

missing_reproducibility_dependency.required: The original frozen row-level mapping from all 335 governed current players (Sleeper IDs) to the historical player/source key used for PIT residual lookup, together with the exact 2024 and 2023 age/state residual inputs—or a provenance-identical row-complete 335-player materialization table containing them.
missing_reproducibility_dependency.why_not_derivable: The activation output retains only Sleeper IDs and aggregate bridge counts. The bridge was based on contemporaneous provider snapshots and unique name+position resolution, but neither the resolved mapping nor those exact snapshots were persisted. Re-running that logic or fetching fresh provider data would make a new identity choice.

minimum_governance_decision: Authorize a replacement identity/materialization coordinate: approve a named, versioned provider snapshot and deterministic collision/unmatched policy; persist the full 335-row Sleeper-to-historical-key crosswalk plus 2024/2023 PIT residual inputs; then re-enter from a new coordinate. This would be a replacement methodology decision, not recovery of the frozen coordinate.
stop_boundary: STOP. Do not substitute a new window, refit, reconstruct identities heuristically, fetch a fresh provider snapshot, materialize Y2/Y3, run sentinel parity, or run Shapley under this authority.
